metadata.status: expanded static investigation; no runtime edit; all post-bypass gameplay pending
limitations: No live hitbox or gameplay test performed.
Animation match is a model/judge association; runtime variation, AI use and animation imports still require qualification.
Routes are shortest witnesses per reachable node; all child links are retained separately.
Map observations include unloaded, disabled and possibly unused placements; they are not proof that an NPC is encountered.
Archive c5501.anibnd.dcx was absent despite dictionary entry.
Player-created/PvP/unused rows occur in broad screening and are not automatically candidates.
P1/P2/P3 rank structural evidence and test order, not proven airborne safety. P2 uses attachment identity without animated world-space pose evaluation.
Map usage retains the first-pass snapshot; no fresh map-placement census in this expansion.
Nearby contacts are a +/-0.25-second witness search, not an exhaustive combo analysis.
Positive gravity and map collision are structural evidence of floor probing, not a simulation of every collision or expiry spawn.

priorityDefinitions.P1: 14 small floor-probe damage rows (radius <=2); no direct BehaviorParam hitbox reference; every known damage bullet short and stationary.
priorityDefinitions.P2: 27 stationary foot/forelimb pulses; strong attachment evidence, animated height and clearance still conditional.
priorityDefinitions.P3: 6 larger floor-probe or delayed floor-pulse rows; additional clearance or sequence gate.

secondReview.status: all priority candidates retained; tiers unchanged

groups.name: Crucible Knight foot waves
groups.reason: Foot dummy, downward floor probe, stationary short-lived radius-1 child; original Hadeon stomp jumpability author-confirmed, bypass trial pending.

groups.name: Godfrey ordinary waves
groups.reason: Two non-damaging carriers precede radius-1.2 child; six animated behavior roots share it. Full-screen versions are separate.

groups.name: Hoarah Loux ordinary waves
groups.reason: Same floor-probe architecture and radius-1.2 child; six animated behavior roots. Separate body/grab and full-screen contacts.

groups.name: Devonia foot and hammer waves
groups.reason: Floor probes create radius-1 damage children. One row serves both foot and hammer origins, so test both before accepting shared edit.

groups.name: Messmer Soldier foot wave
groups.reason: Left-foot dummy 4 and floor probe; radius-1 child. Five timeline entries share the route.

groups.name: Beast Clergyman Beast Claw
groups.reason: Floor-contact chains, radius 1.5, 0.09/0.15 seconds; airborne flag absent. Include Gurranq and boss/shared users in tests. Expanded review: every linked damage bullet is stationary and short, and every BehaviorParam route passes a floor probe; whole-combo/shared-user and post-bypass tests still pending.

groups.name: Promised Consort Radahn local wave
groups.reason: Foot-origin candidate at animation 3009; radius-1.2 floor impact, but the same damaging attack row also serves both carriers. Airborne flag absent.

groups.name: Devonia transformed waves
groups.reason: Floor probes and radius-1 impacts, but multiple hand/beast-limb emissions and timing require whole-combo jump qualification. Expanded review: every linked damage bullet is stationary and short, and every BehaviorParam route passes a floor probe; whole-combo/shared-user and post-bypass tests still pending.

groups.name: Godskin Noble rapier ground burst
groups.reason: Radius 1.5, 0.2-second pulse tied to rapier impacts; separate blade contact and repeated thrusts before removing rolls.

groups.name: Local Troll ground impacts
groups.reason: Selected 2.3-2.5 radius, 0.2-second local bursts; not approval for all 49 air-flagged rows per family.

groups.name: Demi-Human Queen local bursts
groups.reason: Small local bursts; identify staff/body companion hits and verify terrain and repeated pulses.

groups.name: Avatar ground waves
groups.reason: Strong move attribution, but 7.5/4.0 radii can depend on airborne invulnerability rather than physical clearance. Exclude body and rot.

groups.name: Godrick axe-ground pulses
groups.reason: Traced triple and double pulse timelines. Radii 4.5/9; qualify every pulse and close axe contact.

groups.name: Fire Giant foot bursts
groups.reason: Separate 3.5-radius short-lived bursts; leave foot/body attack rows alone.

groups.name: Misbegotten foot stomp
groups.reason: Direct foot-origin candidate, radius 2; animated geometry still required; do not include rising/jumping body blast.

groups.name: Duelist hammer-ground contacts
groups.reason: Two radius-1 spheres on hammer bones, not feet. Timeline 1003005 at 2.400/2.467 seconds; only eligible if hammer contact stays low during active windows.

groups.name: Elemer shield-ground AoE
groups.reason: Direct radius-2.5 sphere; airborne flag off. Separate shield swing and verify dummy motion before inclusion.

groups.name: Grafted Scion ground AoE
groups.reason: Radius-2 direct sphere, dummy 230, timeline 3008; separate shield contact 4690180.

groups.name: Pumpkin Head impact burst
groups.reason: Short local 2/1.6-radius pulses; direct hitbox data also exists. Thin variant inherited timelines need further resolution.

groups.name: Golem Smith short impacts
groups.reason: Short 1.5/2/3.5-radius pulses; exclude separate 2-second attack 5260221 and check heat/body companions.

groups.name: Godfrey and Hoarah large waves
groups.reason: 7.5/50/50 radii; full-screen waves already ignore guard, not rolls. Physical jump clearance cannot be assumed.

groups.name: Radagon ground/hammer bursts
groups.reason: Separate direct contact, ground burst and holy follow-up; radii range 2-6.3 and attack definitions alone do not establish low height.

groups.name: Starscourge Radahn physical waves
groups.reason: Candidate ground-impact children; radius up to 3.5; distinguish sword/body contact and gravity phases.

groups.name: Starscourge Radahn magic waves
groups.reason: Separate from physical group; inspect delayed/rising gravity components before removing rolls.

groups.name: Dragonkin selected ground bursts
groups.reason: Local 3.5-5-radius volumes; keep hand sweeps and ice/lightning separate; wider 37-row family not approved.

groups.name: Guardian Golem selected impacts
groups.reason: Potential local ground bursts, but varied 2.1-5.2-radius children and body contacts; review per move and DLC copy.

groups.name: Ancestor Spirit ground wave
groups.reason: Radius-4 short burst shared by multiple animations; preserve hoof/body damage and separate dive.

groups.name: Fallingstar foot AoE
groups.reason: Short radius-3 foot burst; retain charge/body, gravity pull and large explosion separately.

groups.name: Tree Sentinel local impacts
groups.reason: Shield/horse local effects up to 5.5 radius; confirm actual ground shockwave versus mounted body collision.

groups.name: Draconic Tree Sentinel impacts
groups.reason: Selected physical/local bursts; exclude fireball and lightning families even where airborne flag is set.

groups.name: Margit hammer impact
groups.reason: 3.5-radius short burst, jump/hammer overlap and cross-animation reuse; not a blanket hammer unblockability change.

groups.name: Furnace Golem rings
groups.reason: Well-traced stomp/jump chains, radius 6. Landing flames and several long paths need separate jump tests.

groups.name: Rellana three moon pulses
groups.reason: Three damage rows traced to animation 3036; expanding 50-radius spheres make airborne-flag dependence a major concern.

groups.name: Putrescent Knight flame waves
groups.reason: Long child chains with brief pulses but radii up to 42; verify wave-front versus filled volume and whole sequence, including return waves.

groups.name: Elden Beast ring push
groups.reason: Radius-1.2 child lives 3.5 seconds; low-looking moving ring is promising but carrier lifetime and ring path must be inspected.

groups.name: Valiant Gargoyle stomp
groups.reason: Bullet 4770253, radius 5, airborne flag absent; separate foot and poison effects.

groups.name: Godskin Noble landing wave
groups.reason: Radius 9.5; leave falling-body 3570260 and knockaway 3570261 separate.

groups.name: Magma Wyrm ground crush
groups.reason: Large direct spheres, 7.5/8 radius, attached to body/weapon pose; not an initial low-wave edit.

groups.name: Dragon foot bursts
groups.reason: 5-7-radius selected bursts. Exclude tail, breath, direct feet and ghostflame companions; other dragon variants remain screened, not approved.

groups.name: Walking Mausoleum footsteps
groups.reason: Environmental extension; radii 6/11/30, moving feet and terrain make it lower priority than combat waves.

groups.name: Gaius local ground effects
groups.reason: 2-3.2-radius local bursts; exclude charge and larger gravity attacks 5000611/612.

groups.name: Runebear local ground AoEs
groups.reason: Attached radius-3.5 volumes need moving-pose clearance; separate grabs/body contacts.

groups.name: Starcaller floor eruptions
groups.reason: Small floor-probe children, but many roots, direct emissions and variant behavior states. Verify spike visuals and vertical collision before adopting.

groups.name: Horned Warrior floor effects
groups.reason: Mixed wind/elemental chains; floor-probe match is insufficient, especially repeated and rising effects.

groups.name: Great Red Bear claw wave
groups.reason: Short floor impacts share attack with radius-3 close pulse; isolate the low component or qualify every shared bullet.

groups.name: Ancient Dragon stake wave
groups.reason: Floor-probe match also shares many lightning bullets and direct roots. Isolate low travelling component before considering bypass.

groups.name: Watchdog head projectile
groups.reason: Remove from high-confidence stomp list: dummy 40 is HeadSub; damaging parent shoots at -3 degrees, 35 speed, followed by five child generations. Not the floor-probe stomp architecture.

groups.name: Devonia unreferenced variant
groups.reason: No incoming HitBulletID/interval edge or BehaviorParam root found; active 205800661 points to 205800653 instead. Other spawn mechanisms not exhaustively excluded.

groups.name: Death Rite Bird shared ghostflame
groups.reason: Small 0.1-second floor impacts share damage row with 5-second lingering bullet. Row-wide bypass would affect both; no blanket edit.

groups.name: Lingering Bloodfiend effects
groups.reason: Small radius is misleading: 5-second damage bullets do not fit a single readable jump counter.

groups.name: Lingering Prelate fire
groups.reason: Radius 1 but lifetime 5 seconds and repeated emissions. Exclude from low single-pulse conversion.

groups.name: Ground pull and giant explosions
groups.reason: Rising gravity, wide blasts or pull-up effects; not evidence of a low jumpable wave.

groups.name: Separate body and weapon contacts
groups.reason: Preserve distinct descending body/shield/axe contacts. Same move name does not authorize converting all contacts.

groups.name: Radagon compact gravity-probe waves
groups.reason: Separate damage children after gravity-100 map-colliding probes; radius 2, 0.15/0.21 seconds, no shared direct attack behavior. Ground identity strong; no live clearance proof.

groups.name: Additional Troll foot bursts
groups.reason: New FLVER landmarks resolve every origin to left/right FootTwist. Independent stationary radius-2.3, 0.2-second damage bullets; direct foot contacts use separate rows. Animated foot height and overlapping combo windows remain unverified.

groups.name: Ancestor Spirit forelimb pulses
groups.reason: Both forelimb digit attachments in four animations; stationary radius 1.8, life 0.15; separate direct contact 4670181 in the first witness. Test each emission and hoof/body overlap.

groups.name: Radagon wider gravity-probe wave
groups.reason: Gravity-100 floor probe; damage expands to radius 3 over a 0.21-second life. Clear routing, wider jump-clearance risk than compact Radagon waves.

groups.name: Black Knight great-hammer holy ground waves
groups.reason: Fresh c5840 timelines connect great-club dummy 11 to gravity-100 map probes and separate radius-3, 0.21-second damage children. Neither has the airborne bit; qualify both variants.

groups.name: Radagon delayed floor detonations
groups.reason: Gravity floor placement followed by attack-1 visual/delay nodes, including a two-second timer, then short separate damage. Qualify telegraph, full pulse train and intervening attack; a delay is not continuous damaging lifetime.

groups.name: Tree Sentinel halberd impact bursts
groups.reason: Halberd-tip dummy 81, radius 2 and life 0.2; separate direct weapon rows. Pose at emission is not measured, so retain secondary priority until confirmed ground contact.

groups.name: Guardian swordspear impact pulses
groups.reason: Spear attachment, radius 1.5 and life 0.1, separate weapon contact. Shared across many animations; every pose must be qualified before changing the shared row.

groups.name: Additional Troll hand and weapon pulses
groups.reason: Small separate pulses, but hand/weapon origins do not establish floor placement. Keep behind the explicit foot subset; do not convert their whole family.

groups.name: Dragonkin toe-impact subset
groups.reason: New dummies resolve right/left toes in 3029 and 1003029. Radius 3.5 and nearby hand pulses make whole-combo jumpability less certain than Troll foot bursts.

groups.name: Radagon travelling holy-floor components
groups.reason: These damage rows travel at 20/24 rather than the stationary delayed children. Require path-height and whole-sequence review separately from delayed floor detonations.

groups.name: Consort Radahn holy stomp extension
groups.reason: Right-foot origin and floor probe, but the same damage row serves carrier, probe and radius-2.4 child. Do not apply child-only reasoning to a row-wide edit.

groups.name: Scadutree Avatar ground-probe impacts
groups.reason: New animations 3005/3006 resolve repeated hand-launched chains and radius-3.2 child; thorn/hand visuals, repetition and vertical clearance remain to be checked.

groups.name: Dancing Lion low-projectile variants
groups.reason: Head-launched -60-degree parents share damage with moving children. Floor contact alone does not make these isolated low waves; splitting or full-route qualification needed.

groups.name: Golem Smith thrown-impact child
groups.reason: New child-only radius-2 row reached by -60-degree hand projectiles. Throw/landing readability and launch condition need review; not evidence of a stomp.

groups.name: Guardian Golem bow-impact false positives
groups.reason: Fresh model data puts animation roots on L_Bow001. Some descendants hit floors, but these are bow-fired routes, not the previously implied local stomp impacts. Exclude from simple ground-counter expansion.

groups.name: Small mouth and torso false positives
groups.reason: Giant Dog origin is Jaw, Guardian is Spine2, Troll is L_mouth. Small brief damage spheres alone do not establish ground-wave identity.

groups.name: Graven School long-lived shared damage
groups.reason: Same row serves a ten-second bullet and short final child; exclude simple row-wide conversion.

groups.name: Ally and holy-seeker false positives
groups.reason: Melina is outside the selected hostile-ground-wave scope; holy-seeker families include additional small strike components and are not established low jump counters. Do not promote solely on gravity probing.
